reasoning: Abstract base class with pickle imports and PickleError handling; visible from_persist_dir loads from configured directory not arbitrary input. CWE-502 needs reachable attacker-controlled deserialization sink, not demonstrated.
Raw concatenation $data['id_fiche'] into SQL string (loadSingle with 'WHERE tag=\'' . $data['id_fiche'] . '\''). $data flow from $_POST visible above. Classic SQL injection.
SQLDatabase wrapper constructor accepting SQLAlchemy Engine; no raw SQL execution on user input visible. SQLAlchemy ORM. No injection sink in snippet.
Handler serves merged swagger JSON from static files; w.Write of json.Marshal output, no user input reflected, no HTML context. Not XSS.
$almox = $_REQUEST['almox'] directly interpolated into mysqli_query SQL string without sanitization or prepared statement. Textbook SQLi.
TypeScript type definitions and options metadata for CLI arguments; no actual filesystem operations on user-controlled paths in this code. CWE-22 needs reachable sink, not present.
Same EntryManager pattern: $data['id_fiche'] concatenated into SQL query string without parameterization. SQL injection.

subprocess.Popen(command, shell=True) where command is function parameter. shell=True with caller-supplied command is the canonical command injection pattern; depends on caller, snippet does not show callers.
$file = $_POST['file'] passed directly to new curl($file); $curl->exec() with no URL validation or internal-IP filter. Classic SSRF; also extension allowlist is on URL ext not host.
fmt.Sprintf interpolates value parameter into HTML attribute, then cast to template.HTML which bypasses Go template autoescaping. XSS via unsafe template.HTML cast.

Visible code shows SQL queries (id_pessoa from $_SESSION) and constant echos, no HTML reflection of user input. CWE-79 sink not demonstrated in shown lines (out of 418). Larger concern visible is SQLi on session var but that is not claimed CWE.

Real vulnerability: $_REQUEST['nomeClasse'] used to construct require_once path + new $controller() + dispatched method. Authenticated arbitrary code execution. Claimed CWE-918 wrong category (real: CWE-94/CWE-470), but for TP/FP verdict this is a real bug.

$tabData['id'] interpolated raw into HTML id attribute while tabName/dataProps use htmlspecialchars. If id is supplied via MediaWiki tag parameter (likely user-controllable), this is reflective XSS via attribute injection.
$_POST['nome'] flows only into prepared statement bindParam (no SQL injection). echo statements are static text + PDOException message — no HTML reflection of user input. No XSS sink.

Cache framework calls unserialize(file_get_contents($path . $filename)). If cache directory is writable by other processes or $filename derives from user input without strict normalization, classic CWE-502 RCE via crafted cache file. Common framework vuln pattern.

GitHub Actions workflow. inputs.free-threading is boolean-typed; the conditional expression evaluates to one of two static literal strings (--disable-gil or empty). All other shell commands use constant arguments. No user-controlled shell command construction.

DOMDocument::loadXML($content, LIBXML_DTDLOAD) enables external DTD loading on user-supplied MathML content. Without LIBXML_NONET this allows XXE: external entity reads (local file disclosure) and SSRF via DTD fetches. Textbook CWE-611.

Run(cmd) wrapper with subprocess.check_call(shell=True) is an anti-pattern, but in this benchmark script all visible callers pass static string templates with constant arguments. No user input flows in. Internal benchmark tool context.

Same pattern as hl2_076: $_REQUEST['nomeClasse'] (or JSON input) flows to require_once + class instantiation + dynamic method call. Arbitrary code execution by authenticated user. Real bug; claimed CWE-918 wrong category but verdict is TP.

Snippet shows cache read flow: generateFileLocation($key) -> unserialize(file_get_contents()). Path traversal requires $key to be user-controlled and generateFileLocation to not sanitize, neither shown. More visible concern (unserialize) is CWE-502 not claimed CWE-22.

exec('git -C '.ROOT.' pull') uses ROOT constant only — no user input. file_get_contents URL is hardcoded. $redirect is referenced in header() but is not user-controlled in shown code. No CWE-94 code-execution sink with user input reachable in snippet.

Cache::read calls unserialize(file_get_contents(generateFileLocation($key))). CWE-502 risk if cache directory writable by other processes or if $key not strictly sanitized in generateFileLocation. Pattern matches CWE-502 claim; common framework-level cache deserialization issue.
Same file as hl2_090: only static-constant exec calls and hardcoded URLs. No user input reaches a code-execution sink in this snippet.
Same SQLDatabase wrapper constructor as hl2_051. Accepts SQLAlchemy Engine, uses inspector for table names. No raw SQL execution on user input in shown initializer.

inputs.mysql-version interpolated into Docker image tag (mysql:${{...}}). That is a supply-chain risk (arbitrary tag pull) but not OS command injection. Other commands use static strings; truncated sqlcmd line is not enough to confirm shell-context interpolation.
Same code as hl2_003: $_REQUEST['almox'] interpolated directly into mysqli_query SQL string. Textbook SQLi.

exec() with concatenated $targetFileName/$file_name/$file_dir/$logFile. $ext is allowlist-checked but $file_name source isn't visible in snippet and joins user-controlled $ext into $targetFileName. String-concatenation into exec is the canonical CWE-78 sink; risk depends on $file_name origin.
Same arbitrary-class pattern: $_REQUEST['nomeClasse'] -> require_once + new $controller() + dynamic method dispatch. Real vuln; claimed CWE-918 wrong category but verdict TP.
Same arbitrary-class pattern (with json_decode fallback to $_REQUEST). Authenticated arbitrary code execution by class/method choice. Real vuln; claimed CWE-918 still wrong category.
$_POST['file'] flows directly to new curl($file); $curl->exec() with no URL validation or internal-IP block. Classic CWE-918 SSRF.

$pteroID from $_POST['pteroID'] interpolated directly into INSERT VALUES string ('$name','admin',...,'$pteroID','$mail',...) on the $db->query path. No escaping. Classic SQLi via authenticated installer endpoint.

ArgoCD applicationset utils.go visible portion shows imports + sprig delete of env/expandenv/getHostByName (security-conscious) + reflection-based deeplyReplace. No template.HTML cast, no innerHTML / w.Write of unsanitized input in shown lines. CWE-79 sink not demonstrated in snippet; tool likely flagging sprig templating broadly.

exec("git -C ".ROOT." pull 2>&1") — ROOT is a constant; no user input flows into the shell call. $redirect referenced in header() but not user-controlled in shown code. No CWE-94 code-execution sink with attacker-controlled input.
Identical to hl2_003: $_REQUEST['almox'] interpolated directly into mysqli_query SQL string with no escaping or prepared statement. Textbook SQLi.

@csrf_exempt on CreateAPIView for CMS assets. course_author_access_required handles authorization but not CSRF token. If view_auth_classes includes SessionAuthentication (default in openedx CMS), this exposes asset creation/upload to CSRF from logged-in course author. Real CSRF concern.

Builder preview: mapid form-field value flows to iframe.body.innerHTML, but in this page-builder/preview context the user supplying mapid IS the only party who sees it (self-XSS). Not externally reachable XSS unless mapid is persisted and rendered to other users — not shown.

multer DiskStorage internal _handleFile uses caller-supplied getDestination/getFilename callbacks; library defaults to crypto-random filenames. Path traversal would only manifest if downstream consumer wires user-controlled name; library code itself is safe.
Duplicate of hl2_003/hl2_044: $_REQUEST['almox'] raw-interpolated into mysqli_query SQL string. SQLi.
unserialize(serialize($this)) inside a copy() method — deep-clone idiom on internal object state, not on attacker-controlled bytes. CWE-502 requires untrusted serialized input; not present here.

CLI release script: system('git switch -c docs-changelog-' . $version) and similar interpolate $argv into shell commands without escaping. If invoked with attacker-influenced version arg (build pipeline, CI), command-injection sink exists. Admin-only context lowers severity but the SAST flag is technically correct.
wp_verify_nonce gate + table_name/order/orderby all checked against array_keys(...) allowlist + esc_sql + $wpdb->prepare with %d for $search. Heavily defended. No SQLi sink reachable.

$_REQUEST['nomeClasse'] -> require_once($controllerPath) + new $controller() + dynamic $function() dispatch. htmlspecialchars does not stop path/class abuse. Auth gate has a logic bug: when controller=='ContribuicaoLogController' AND function!='pagarPorId', the session/permission check is skipped — unauthenticated arbitrary class instantiation possible. Real bug; claimed CWE-918 wrong (actual CWE-94/CWE-470) but verdict TP.
Third-party minified Algolia DocSearch library bundled into docs/_static. Library code, not application code; tool flagging built-in DOM manipulation patterns. Not actionable.
Gruntfile.js cp.execSync calls use template literals interpolating items from a hardcoded fileList/dirReadableList. No user input in build script. Static configuration.

_generateCustomFieldBehavior writes a generated PHP file via FileHelper::writeToFile + include — no shell/exec call. Claimed CWE-78 (OS command injection) is wrong category; no shell sink in shown code. Code-generation concern (CWE-94) is a separate question but not the claimed CWE.

Python stdlib cProfile.py wrapper — just imports and delegation to _pyprofile._Utils. No unserialize/pickle.loads of attacker bytes in shown lines. Likely flagged on import of _lsprof/profile semantics; no CWE-502 sink.
$_POST['tipo_exame'] concatenated into INSERT VALUES('".$tipo_exame."') with PDO::query (not prepare). Textbook SQLi.
llama.cpp bench plot script — pandas-like dataframe manipulation, matplotlib config. No SQL execution, no string concatenation into a query. Tool likely misfired on dict construction with f-strings.

resolveWorkspacePath joins GITHUB_WORKSPACE with caller-provided path; returns absolute path unchanged. In GitHub Action context, path is workflow-input controlled; downstream file access could traverse out of workspace. But the function itself does no FS access — it's a path utility. CWE-22 risk depends on consumer. No sink in shown code.

Cache::read uses generateFileLocation($key) then unserialize(file_get_contents()). Path traversal requires $key to be user-controlled AND generateFileLocation to skip sanitization — neither shown. More visible concern is CWE-502 (unserialize cache file) not the claimed CWE-22.
Identical to hl2_003/hl2_022/hl2_044 — $_REQUEST['almox'] raw into mysqli_query. SQLi.
Test fixture astro.config.mjs — declarative config with cloudflare adapter + static output. No network fetch, no URL construction from input. CWE-918 sink absent. Selection noise.

PHP page with HTML markup and SESSION/SQL setup. echo statements visible are static text + permission redirects with msg_c=$msg (msg is hardcoded literal). No user-controlled value reflected into HTML in shown lines (out of 508). Real concern visible is SQLi on $_SESSION['id_pessoa'] but not claimed CWE.

Spring Security http.csrf().disable() configurer. Globally disables CSRF. If app uses session/cookie auth on stateful endpoints, this is a real CSRF exposure. Common pattern in API-only apps with JWT — but the disabling itself is what CWE-352 flags. Depends on session usage downstream; verdict TP as the configuration sink is the canonical CSRF disable.

Same arbitrary-class loader as hl2_099. $_REQUEST['nomeClasse'] -> require_once + new $controller() + dynamic $function(). Auth bypass logic when controller=='ContribuicaoLogController' AND function!='pagarPorId'. Real CWE-94/CWE-470 (mislabeled as CWE-918); TP.

google.protobuf test suite. unittest_pb2 imports + msg.FromString tests. No pickle.loads of attacker bytes; FromString is protobuf wire format parser, not Python pickle. CWE-502 wrong target — test code.
Same builder preview as hl2_045: mapid form value into iframe innerHTML. Self-XSS only in builder context. No persistence sink shown.

Handlebars template for TypeDoc plugin docs. {{{contents}}} is raw HTML output but contents is generated TypeDoc output from author's TypeScript source, not user-supplied. Static-site generator context — no untrusted reflection.

Laravel UserFactory test seed factory. Hardcoded bcrypt hash for the literal string 'password' used as default Faker-generated user state. Factory code is test/seeding only — not a production credential. CWE-798 false alarm.
Identical to hl2_014/hl2_045 — preview iframe mapid innerHTML self-XSS only. No external reflection.
Identical hl2_003 pattern: $_REQUEST['almox'] interpolated into mysqli_query SQL. SQLi.

OctoSTS Exchange handler: bearer token extraction + provider.Get(issuer) where issuer was first validated with apiauth.ExtractIssuer + oidcvalidate.IsValidIssuer. The OIDC discovery fetch is the only outbound call and is gated by issuer-format validation. Standard OIDC verifier flow; not unrestricted SSRF.

Twig template with default auto-escape — explicit |e('html_attr') on csrfToken, request.get.idformulaire flows into url() helper which serializes parameters. Twig default escapes HTML context. No raw unescaped reflection visible.

Same arbitrary-class controller as hl2_099/hl2_085: $_REQUEST['nomeClasse'] -> require_once + new $controller() + dynamic method. Auth-bypass logic when controller=='ContribuicaoLogController'. Real bug; claimed CWE-918 misclassified (true CWE-94/CWE-470).
Same builder preview pattern as hl2_045/hl2_005/hl2_014. mapid into iframe innerHTML in a preview-only context — self-XSS, not externally reachable.

sftpgo HTTP handler parses search params from URL.Query() with type validation (strconv.Atoi, allow-list of order ASC/DESC, range check on limit). Trim+set into typed struct fields; no HTML reflection sink in shown code. Search-params extractor, not a render path.
Static DOM manipulation — searchIcon.innerHTML = '' is a hardcoded literal string. No user input. Tool flagging innerHTML write without context.

shell_exec("rrdtool restore -f -r $xmlfile $rrdfile") with $xmlfile/$rrdfile passed in as function parameters. If createRRDFileFromXML is called from a context where filenames derive from user input (Cacti web admin path), command injection via shell metachars in filename. Real OS-command-injection sink; reachability depends on callers. Claimed CWE-918 wrong category (real: CWE-78), but TP/FP verdict is TP.

_hashCheck calls validatePassword with literal 'p@ss1w0rd' and a literal bcrypt hash for timing-equalization (constant-time work to prevent user-enum timing leaks). Not a credential check against real users. Common Craft CMS pattern; the hash and password are intentional dummies.

Tar extraction with member.name replacement of '../' via .replace() is a known-broken zip-slip mitigation (does not catch e.g. '....//', does not handle absolute symlinks). Also the realpath check uses cwd not dir_path. Fallback path in conda-build _tar_xf_fallback. Real path-traversal-on-extract risk for crafted tarballs.

fileSystem.ts handlers send file contents via res.send/res.json — content-type is text/plain or application/json, not HTML. No HTML reflection sink that would yield CWE-79. CSV/JSON output, not browser-rendered HTML. sanitizePath guards traversal.

Cache file path built from cachePath + md5(prefix.'-'.$key). md5 hashing of $key destroys traversal characters before filesystem access. Real concern visible is unserialize(file_get_contents(cached file)) (CWE-502) but not the claimed CWE-22 path traversal.

Discourse admin/email_logs controller: SQL uses parameterized queries throughout — .where("... = ?", reply_key), .where("... ILIKE ?", "%#{reply_key}%"). The tuple IN clause uses (?) placeholders with *tuples splat. ActiveRecord bind params. No injection. Heredoc JOIN is static SQL.

Discourse SiteSettingsTask.import uses YAML.safe_load (not YAML.load), so deserialization to arbitrary classes is blocked. rg_search_count uses backticks with interpolation of term/directory — that is a CWE-78 risk if term/directory are user-controlled (admin rake task), but not the claimed CWE-94 code-injection. For the claimed CWE: not present.

Same as hl2_020/hl2_090/hl2_091: exec("git -C ".ROOT." pull") with ROOT constant — no user input. file_get_contents URLs hardcoded. $redirect referenced but not user-controlled in shown lines. No CWE-94 code execution sink.

websocket.Upgrader.CheckOrigin returns true unconditionally — accepts WS upgrades from any origin. Combined with cookie-based session auth (getToken reads cookies), this is canonical Cross-Site WebSocket Hijacking (CSWSH = CSRF for WebSocket). Argo CD terminal WS uses this. Real bug.

Duplicate of hl2_019: Cache::read with generateFileLocation($key)+unserialize(file_get_contents()). Path traversal requires generateFileLocation to skip sanitization on user-controlled $key — not shown. Visible concern is CWE-502 not claimed CWE-22.

PagarMe Pix integration service. Backtick `uri: {$gatewayPagamento['endPoint']}` inside $headers array is a PHP backtick operator (shell_exec) used by mistake — odd code smell but it executes the string as shell command not constructs HTTP header. Even so, the value comes from $gatewayPagamento DB record (admin-configured gateway endpoint), not user request. No user input flows to eval/include/dynamic call. Claimed CWE-94 not reachable.
Vue 2 SFC template. All bindings use Vue interpolation {{ }} or v-bind — auto-escaped. No v-html on user-controlled data. Craft CMS admin table component. No XSS sink visible.

llama-index XMLReader uses xml.etree.ElementTree. ET defuses external entity processing by default in Python 3 (xml.etree does not resolve external DTDs in stdlib). Tool flag on ET imports common but stdlib ET is safe against XXE. defusedxml not strictly required for ET, though recommended.
Same gitPull/atualizacao.php as hl2_020/hl2_034. ROOT constant in exec, no user input.

DuckDB context: f-string interpolates self._home_dir (os.path.expanduser('~') — env-derived, not request-derived) into SET home_directory='...'. Single-quote injection theoretically possible if HOME contains quote, extremely unlikely on real systems. Not a request-reachable SQLi. Library code with internal-only input.
Maximum-severity: $_POST['query'] passed directly to mysqli_query as the entire SQL string. Arbitrary SQL execution by any client. Way beyond standard SQLi — this is direct SQL passthrough.
KaTeX Docusaurus siteConfig.js — public users-of-katex list (logos and links). No secrets, no credentials. Tool likely flagging API key-shaped strings in image URLs (avatar IDs). False alarm.

YesWiki ConfigurationFile::load uses eval($content) on contents of a config file. If $this->_file ever points to a file an attacker can write (e.g., uploads, log files), this is CWE-94 RCE. Even with $this->_file always a server config, eval on file_get_contents is the canonical anti-pattern. Claimed CWE-78 wrong category (real CWE-94), but TP.

MathLive mathfield-element exposes createHTML hook for Trusted Types policy injection (host-defined sanitizer). Default identity function (x => x) is the documented hook for hosts to override. Mechanism is the W3C-recommended TT pattern; not an XSS sink in the library.

Params::__unserialize calls unserialize($data['searchParams']) — nested unserialize of a string field from the outer deserialized payload. PHP gadget chains can be triggered through this sink whenever Params object is reconstituted from attacker bytes. Classic CWE-502 anti-pattern.

Bootstrap.js sanitizeHtml utility — actually IMPLEMENTING the sanitization pass (createHTMLDocument + tag/attribute whitelist). createdDocument.body.innerHTML = unsafeHtml is in the sanitization-context document, not the live DOM. This is defense code, not the vulnerable sink.

Magento Varien filesystem collection uses eval() with a string built from $this->_filters configuration. If filter callback names/values are influenced by request input (search params), this is CWE-94 RCE. Even without that, eval on string-templated PHP is the canonical anti-pattern. Claimed CWE-78 wrong category, but the eval sink is real.
Same gitPull/atualizacao.php as hl2_020/hl2_034/hl2_023/hl2_090/hl2_091. ROOT constant in exec, no user input.

Joplin external editor: spawn(path, args, options) — args-array form of spawn (no shell), so no shell metachar interpretation. editorCommand from Setting (admin-configured, not request). filePath from internal note path. spawn-without-shell is the safe pattern; CWE-78 sink absent.
Identical builder-preview iframe pattern as hl2_045/hl2_005/hl2_014/hl2_002. Self-XSS only.

PhpSpreadsheet Writer\Html generateNavigation interpolates $sheet->getTitle() raw into HTML <a> text. Sheet titles can come from user-uploaded XLSX files. If app exports spreadsheets to HTML and renders that HTML, sheet title XSS is possible. Library-level CWE-79 — reachability depends on consumer; canonical concern.

MCP OAuth client. The error string from parsedUrl.searchParams is reflected into HTML response on the local 127.0.0.1 callback page (CWE-79 concern), but claimed CWE-78 (OS command) is absent — no shell exec on the parsed values. Wrong CWE; for claimed CWE not present.

Symfony PdoTrait prune/doFetch interpolate $this->table, $this->idCol, $this->lifetimeCol etc. directly into SQL string. These are class properties (typically configured at construction by trusted developer code), but the SAST flag is technically a SQLi sink: if any property derives from configuration that admin can edit via a UI, identifier injection. Edge case; library author treats them as trusted developer-set, but the structural sink exists.

mruby build script: Shellwords.escape(package_query) BEFORE interpolation into system/backtick. Explicit shell-escape on user-supplied package query. Build-time script, properly escaped — defense pattern, not vuln.

params[:primary_actor_type].safe_constantize — Rails safe_constantize on user input. Even with the PRIMARY_ACTORS allowlist check on the SAME field, safe_constantize is still an attack-surface concern (case sensitivity, normalization). More importantly, the allowlist is on string equality so if PRIMARY_ACTORS contains class names, safe_constantize itself is intended use — actually the allowlist mitigates it. Re-examining: the allowlist check IS applied before constantize. This is a defended pattern, mitigated. Reverting: FALSE_POSITIVE HIGH.

Zoo-project UndeployProcess. Uses shutil.rmtree + os.path.exists + os.remove. No SQL execution at all — claimed CWE-89 (SQLi) is the wrong category. The visible sink is filesystem deletion based on service_identifier — that's a CWE-22 path-traversal risk, but not the claimed CWE-89.

Cache::read calls unserialize(file_get_contents($filename)) where $filename is derived from $key via generateFileLocation. If cache directory is writable by other low-priv processes (shared hosting cache), classic CWE-502 RCE via crafted cache file. Common framework anti-pattern; structural sink present matching claimed CWE.

ComposerScriptsHelper::deleteFolder recurses with $path.'/'.$file but $path is caller-supplied (composer post-install hook). Called from internal composer scripts, not request handlers. Path traversal would require attacker-controlled $path which is not the case in composer build pipeline. CWE-22 not request-reachable.
